Unknown fields are silently ignored by Go's JSON unmarshal (standard behavior). For other vector types (BFloat16Vector, Float16Vector, SparseFloatVector, BinaryVector), users must use schema mode with explicit field definitions. This is API design, not a bug - vectorFieldType was never intended as a quick-setup parameter.
